notes.title: Pre-Demo Test Launch
notes.notes:
In preparation for the demo launch in a couple of weeks, there has been several iterations on the battle system:

[list]
[*] Martial Arts skills are now fully fleshed out. You can apply marks and proc them using auto-attacks, or enter stances for self-buffs or auras that affect the party
[*] All skills and spells have mana costs, are learned at certain levels, and have their behavior coded
[*] Enemies have been added to chapters 6 and 7
[*] Balance has been tweaked to ensure the game is possible (though challenging) if you skip all random encounters
[*] Improved the auto-battle AI
[/list]

Planning to do a few pass-throughs and ensure the story is up to par and then we'll get this demo out with the first 7 chapters!

notes.title: Back to work for me
notes.notes:
After a couple of months focusing on family and work, it's time to pick up Trope Tales development again. I'm sure there's some minor improvements in this build over the previous one, but it's all stuff I added to the game months ago and I don't recall what's new and what isn't. Maybe the blizzard in chapter 9 wasn't there before.

One important update, though, is that I've reverted the NW.js version in this build. The newer version of NW.js reduces the memory footprint and fixes some random crashes, but apparently came at the cost of the game not being able to launch on Steamdeck at all.

notes.title: Mac OS version should be available now!
notes.notes: It's my first time doing an upload with 2 depots, so I'm sorry if it doesn't work

notes.title: Update notes for 4/20/2024 - Weapons Upgrade
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed some bugs related to the Sprite Forest and Einstein's Tower (re-entering the Sprite Forest after entering Einstein's Tower made the RPS puzzle impossible)
[*] All cutscenes now rely on variables instead of switches, which should reduce a lot of bugs around cutscenes - particularly if you use the debug menu
[*] All chapters are now limited to 9 switches plus the global chapter switch, meaning 1 chapter per page on the debug menu
[*] The story is completed all the way up to the flying castle (chapter 9)
[*] There two new swords and two new armor for sale in the early shops
[*] You now start with 125/192 XP towards your first level so you don't have to kill as many bats
[*] New icons for all items, weapons, skills, and armor
[*] New descriptions for many weapons and items
[*] Added a secret sword you can find on the first continent
[*] Rewrote all of the logic for the "waiting in line" cutscene to streamline it and make it less buggy... also added dialogue to the people waiting in line!
[*] Unobtainium Sword will now be listed in the shop tables for all stores (added to first continent so far)
[*] While not obtainable in the game yet, there are about 15 new unique swords that I'll be slowly scattering throughout the world
[*] Updated NW.js to 0.69.1 for the Windows version (Mac crashes on this NW.js version) - improved performance and stability
[*] I haven't done the full combat re-balance I want yet, but it's been long enough since I made an update I figure I might as well push this out.
[/list]

notes.title: Catching up to Beta branch
notes.notes:
With the official Trope Tales Steam page launching today, updating the playtest build to match the latest beta version of the game available to internal developers.

Going forward I will direct friends and family to utilize the playtest build, rather than the internal beta build, so that I only have one Steam package to update when I make changes.
